posts.name: IKerensky
posts.cooked:
Just received the box and my global impression is rather mixed.

 

Manual and counters looks good, plenty of space to store the cards.

I have serious concern about the cards. 

1- There is a lot of wasted space with extra large border wich make the image looks tiny, meaning the cards will be harder to recognize.

2- The font used is VERY unsatisfying : it is far too thin and small to be easily readable from about a foot away, definitely not from across the table. The narrow font tends to blur with the card background. And given the large empty space on the cards you could have used a police at least 2pts bigger.

3- First card I look, first line and I find a typo :"Accelerated Deilvery", that dont make for a good first impression.

The minis are nice but look very fragile and the dragon is disapointing compared to what was posted during the KS campaign. I think I will use the tokens, they are more distinguishable.

The expansion is a big box for very small content. Doesnt really justify the cost of the heavy cardboard box, could have been sold in a plastic wrapper.

I will try a game tonight to see if things get better playing it as that is the most important thing, but this is a uphill battle due to thoses box opening concern.

posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
ok, let's see

1 and 2 are valid enough, I suppose. More a matter of personal taste, really -- not an objective FLAW, per se -- but opinions are still good to have.

3, you found ONE TYPO. The fact that it HAPPENED to be on the FIRST CARD YOU LOOKED AT was completely coincidental. There are typos in SOTM, too. Remember the Checmical explosion? Even with the playtesters revising, it's easy to miss something like that. It happens.

4.) (since you stopped numbering them) the minis are nigh-on indestructible. They posted a video on the kickstarter of him TRYING to break one, and he couldn't. I'll admit, Nyotan is a little derpy looking, but they are all perfectly distinguishable.

5.) The expansion is designed to fit into the bigger box and be used to hold stuff, like a divider. I use it to hold my minis. And boxes SELL better than plastic wrap. I don't see why they would want to go that route. It's just poor presentation.

posts.name: IKerensky
posts.cooked:
Ok,

after one play there is my feelings : game is good, very good, sentinel's good.

As I feared tiny cards text make things a bit hard on my back as I have to repetedly move over the opposing ships and station cards to read them. Unexpectedly Defense symboles are hard to see on the Red card textbox for my colorblind eyes... Are they blue or Purple ? I had to close check once or twice.

Rules are well written and the manual is gorgeous.

Each of the different ship have a lot of personnality.

I used tokens and it worked very well, as I wont paint the minis I probably wont use them.

About the expansion box I have no space to put it in the main boxes because of the mini box, and I wont use it to store things as Sector cards are hard to get away from it.

There is still question bout the rules... Wich is logical in a card game. When a card tell me to recycle a station card does that mean recycle it into my ship deck ?
